lectionem quatuor aut quinque dies di-
stuli, donec aliis curis expedito huic

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. Catchword "to hæc" and signature "O 2" read clearly. The initial A is a large woodcut letter joined to "ccepi" as printed.
